patch.value: Restore strict unknown-key parity for docs linked-artifact additions

GH-1000 reproduces a regression against closed pm-0v9k: files --add rejects an unrecognized left-hand key while docs --add accepts the same malformed key=value shape as a literal path. Restore the shared SDK parser boundary without removing intentional bare values, and prove parity across CLI and SDK transports.

docs --add rejects unknown key=value forms with the same allowed-key refusal as files --add; bare paths and URLs containing no assignment syntax remain accepted; malformed URL-plus-note input cannot mutate tracker state; files/docs CLI and SDK parser parity is tested in a temporary tracker; GH-1000 is linked in evidence
